provenance.name: Printers for Ants Micron CNC carriage assembly
provenance.scope: Selected X-normal cylinders from the STEP are redrawn in (Y,Z-18.89933933439): R1.5 axes at Y=+/-8 and Z=11.39933933439/26.39933933439 establish the 16 x 15 mm mounting pattern; the alternate Y=+/-5 positions establish 10 x 15. R3.5 counterbores at Y=+/-12.5,Z=33.2497800904261 establish the 25 mm belt-fastener pitch. The continuous stepped body is schematic; no solid or manufacturing guarantee is provided.
